semiconductor_relevance: High — KOFLOC manufactures precision flow control components essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: KOFLOC specializes in high-precision flow meters and control devices tailored for semiconductor applications. Their products, such as the ST-500 Metal Seal Mass Flow Controller and FML-300 Compact Karman Vortex Flow Meter, are designed to enhance fluid measurement and control in processes like CVD, cleaning, and etching.
capabilities: ST-500 Metal Seal Mass Flow Controller with built-in PI control
FML-300 Compact Karman Vortex Flow Meter with temperature compensation
Digital Mass Flow Controller/Mass Flow Meter with display
Multi-range function for precise flow control
